text: - **Harness ↔ event pipeline, a single select's list:** `select_popup` (25) reads the engine's list through harness input, in both layout modes — a click, Enter and Space opening it on its chosen option and firing nothing; the keys moving the highlight over enabled rows and choosing nothing, the pointer moving it to an enabled row; Enter, Space, Tab and a click choosing a row, one `input` then one `change`, Tab before focus moves either way, the chosen option firing nothing and a disabled row changing nothing; Escape, a second click, a click outside and the page scrolling closing with no event; a label's click focusing the select and opening nothing; a disabled, inert, hidden, singular or empty select opening nothing, and one made inert, disabled, hidden or removed with its list open closing; an option dropped with the list open no row; the tree reading the list open on the select, its focus staying there, an author's `aria-expanded` and `open` steering nothing; a box that clips the select clipping no row; a pointer at a row's centre landing on it, scrolled or not; groups read as headers, a header choosing nothing; a long list showing twenty rows and scrolling by key and wheel; hostile markup (`size`, 2,000 options, a 5,500-character label) keeping every box finite; `size` on a `multiple` select making it that many rows tall; each open, move, scroll and close asking a redraw. One row skips its key press: a key pressed after an ancestor gained `hidden` panics at `packages/blitz-dom/src/node/node.rs:1775`, for any control, with no list opened, the test's comment saying why (tests/blitz-tests/tests/select_popup.rs:202-1186; as measured at escher-0.3.0/chunks/2026-10-31-select-popup/report.md)
